name_zh: 阿曼·蒂普·普·提布：伊巴德伊玛目与东非贸易帝国
name_en: Oman Tippu Tip: Ibadi Imam & East African Trade Empire
description_zh: 蒂普·普·提布 (1832-1905) 斯瓦希里商人/伊巴德伊玛目代理，控制东非内陆象牙奴隶贸易网络，建立从刚果到赞比西河商业帝国，阿曼苏丹授予总督头衔，连接印度洋与非洲腹地。
description_en: Tippu Tip (1832-1905) Swahili merchant/Ibadi Imam agent, controlled East African interior ivory slave trade network, built commercial empire from Congo to Zambezi, Oman Sultan granted governor title, connecting Indian Ocean with African interior.
reason_zh: 蒂普代表印度洋商业网络如何通过伊巴德教派身份与斯瓦希里文化融合构建跨洲贸易帝国，展示了非国家行为体如何在殖民前非洲实现商业主权，其网络为后世东非经济一体化奠基。
reason_en: Tippu Tip represents how Indian Ocean commercial network built trans-continental trade empire through Ibadi sect identity and Swahili culture fusion, demonstrating how non-state actor achieved commercial sovereignty in pre-colonial Africa, his network founding later East African economic integration.
steps_zh: 研究蒂普早年桑给巴尔商人家庭与伊巴德教育
分析象牙奴隶贸易路线从坦噶尼喀至卢阿拉巴
探讨与利奥波德二世刚果自由国博弈与合作
评估1890s德国东非公司收购其领地与退休
总结伊巴德伊玛目贸易东非赞比亚对印度洋商业文明的奠基
steps_en: Study Tippu Tip early Zanzibar merchant family and Ibadi education
Analyze ivory slave trade routes from Tanganyika to Lualaba
Explore Leopold II Congo Free State game and cooperation
Evaluate 1890s German East Africa Company acquisition of territories and retirement
Summarize Ibadi Imam trade East Africa Zambia foundational role for Indian Ocean commercial civilization
expected_zh: 理解前殖民商业网络如何超越现代国界构建区域经济一体化，掌握伊巴德教派身份作为商业信用机制的独特作用，评估蒂普遗产对东非共同体经济整合的历史渊源。
expected_en: Understand how pre-colonial commercial networks transcended modern borders building regional economic integration, grasp Ibadi sect identity unique role as commercial credit mechanism, evaluate Tippu Tip legacy historical roots for East African Community economic integration.
case_zh: 1832 出生；1860s 象牙贸易巅峰；1890s 退休；1905 逝世。伊巴德伊玛目贸易东非赞比亚范式永存。
case_en: 1832 birth; 1860s ivory trade peak; 1890s retirement; 1905 death. Ibadi Imam trade East Africa Zambia paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Indian Ocean Commercial Networks / Ibadi Cosmopolitanism
cross_cultural_impact: Trans-continental trade; ivory/slave trade; Ibadi identity; Congo colonization
